questions.questionTextEn: Selva forests are characterized by :
questions.questionTextHi: सेल्वा वनों की विशेषता है:
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) Broad leaf evergreen. Forests found in the Amazon River Basin in Brazil are called Selva or Selva's forests. These forests are located in the equatorial region. Due to high temperature and above- average rainfall (200 cm) throught the year, dense and broad leaf evergreen forests are found here. [U.P. B.E.O. (Pre) 2019]

(पूर्व) 2019]

questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following countries has a constitutional provision for maintaining 60% of its geographical area under forest?
questions.questionTextHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस देश में अपने भौगोलिक क्षेत्र का 60% जंगल के अंतर्गत रखने का संवैधानिक प्रावधान है?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) Bhutan. Bhutan has made constitutional provision for maintaining forest over 60% of its total geographical area. Presently (in 2021), about 71.5 percent of Bhutan's total area is under forest cover. [U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2016]

optionsEn: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is the correct explanation for Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is not the correct explanation for Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect.
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct.
optionsHi: कथन-I और कथन-II दोनों सही हैं और कथन-II कथन-I के लिए सही स्पष्टीकरण है

questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D) Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct.. Notably, tropical rainforests have higher temperatures and more moisture than the other regions, which accelerates the decomposition of dead organic matter in the soil and releases nutrients more rapidly. [I.A.S. (Pre) 2023]

questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित पेड़ों पर विचार करें: 1. कटहल (आर्टोकार्पस हेटरोफिलस) 2. महुआ (मधुका इंडिका) 3. सागौन (टेक्टोना ग्रैंडिस) उपरोक्त में से कितने पर्णपाती पेड़ हैं?
questions.explanation_en: Correct Answer: (B) Only two. Native to India and Malaysia, Jackfruit tree is an evergreen tree and approx. 25 m tall. This trees produce latex and spreads to Sri Lanka, China, South-East Asia and to tropical regions of Africa. [I.A.S. (Pre) 2023]
